correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the recursively defined Boolean reduct: comparison (#phi >= #psi) becomes constant determined by beta(b(phi)) versus beta(b(psi)), all Boolean operators commute with reduct. Structural induction ensures all-vertex equivalence for subformulas except exponentially small probability. For each v the n summands E_vu(1_A(col(u))-1_B(col(u))) are independent, bounded and of mean rho(delta); Hoeffding plus union over n gives exponential simultaneous sign concentration when delta!=0. Full Boolean bias forces identical truth tables at delta=0, hence every term vanishes identically and >= ties are correctly true even with shared colours. Explicit biases pi_i=1/(1+2^(2^i)) give atom weights distinct powers of two over 2^(2^k)-1, realizing each Boolean-probability j/D exactly once. Independently checked unique subset sums for k<=4, including endpoints; this does not replace asymptotic proof. The asserted exponential law and attainable-limit spectrum follow for every fixed formula.

limitations: Independent directed edges and loops, fixed positive rho, finite fixed formula and colours, full Boolean bias; sparse, undirected or growing-formula regimes are excluded.
